app.name: Fuelx
app.tagline: Nutrition and strength & conditioning for club athletes, managed by their coaches.

landing.kicker: For clubs, teams and their athletes
landing.sub: Coaches add their athletes, upload InBody scans and set the season and match days. Every athlete gets a 4-week nutrition plan and a sport-specific strength & conditioning program that adjusts with weekly check-ins.
landing.price: {price} per athlete per month · cancel anytime

inbody.title: InBody in seconds
inbody.body: Coaches or athletes snap the scan. AI reads the numbers; you confirm them.

plan.title: Fuel for training and matches
plan.body: Exact macros for training, match and rest days, using Egyptian foods athletes actually eat.

train.title: Sport-specific S&C
train.body: Strength, power, speed and injury prevention built for the sport and season phase, planned around match days.

track.title: Calories left, live
track.body: Athletes tick off meals or log any food and see exactly how much they have left.

checkin.title: Coach dashboard
checkin.body: See every athlete's weight trend, adherence and check-ins, and who needs attention.

lang.title: عربي & English
lang.body: The whole app in Egyptian Arabic or English. Switch anytime.

landing.disclaimer: FUELX gives general fitness and nutrition guidance and is not medical advice. Check with a doctor if you have a medical condition.
landing.ctaTitle: Your squad's first 4-week plans are ready in minutes.

onboarding.title: Build your profile
onboarding.subtitle: Two minutes. We'll use this to set your calories, macros and training.

CUT.title: Reduce body fat / make weight
CUT.body: Lose fat while keeping strength and power.

BULK.title: Gain lean mass
BULK.body: Add muscle with a controlled surplus.

RECOMP.title: Recomp
RECOMP.body: Lose fat and build muscle at the same time.

PERFORMANCE.title: Performance
PERFORMANCE.body: Fuel training and competition. Weight stays stable.

MAINTAIN.title: Maintain
MAINTAIN.body: Hold your current weight and body composition.

onboarding.weekdaysHint: Pick 1–4 gym days on top of team practice. Sessions are planned around match days.

errors.weekdays: Choose between 1 and 4 strength & conditioning days.

onboarding.ageHint: Athletes must be 16 or older. Under 18, your coach confirms guardian consent before your plan starts.

checkin.title: Weekly check-in
checkin.fromScan: Taken from your new InBody scan.
checkin.weightHint: Weigh in after waking, before eating.
checkin.notesPlaceholder: Anything we should know? Injuries, travel, competition…

errors.NO_PLAN: You don't have an active plan.

checkin.blockComplete: Your 4-week block is complete. Add a new InBody scan to start the next one.

reasons.LOW_ADHERENCE: Macros unchanged: focus on sticking to the plan first.
reasons.TOO_SLOW_OR_GAINING: Above your target range: calories reduced.
reasons.TOO_FAST_OR_LOSING: Below your target range: calories increased.

checkin.newTargets: New targets: {training} kcal on training days, {rest} kcal on rest days.

followup.LOW_ADHERENCE: Adherence was low this week, so we kept your macros the same. Weigh your food and prep meals ahead to hit your numbers.
followup.ON_TRACK: You're right on target. Same macros, same effort.
followup.TOO_SLOW_OR_GAINING: Your weight trend was above target, so we cut {delta} kcal a day, mostly from carbs. Protein stays the same.
followup.TOO_FAST_OR_LOSING: Your weight trend was below target, so we added {delta} kcal a day to protect muscle and performance.
followup.training: You completed {pct}% of your planned sessions.
followup.newBlock: Block complete! Add a new InBody scan to build your next 4 weeks.

phaseHints.IN_SEASON: Keep strength and stay fresh for matches. Low volume.
